Potential Risk / Confound: Data leakage across identical flow bursts
Mitigation Strategy: Deduplicated all 123k raw records into 17,710 unique flows; reduced duplicate leakage rate from 76.06% to 0.45%
Capacity-matched supervised MLP to exact 13,569 parameter architecture; calibrated losses with BCE to prevent collapse
Employed budget-matched validation subsets (<= 100 flows) for low-label checkpointing
Mapped legitimate IoT operational telemetry (ThingSpeak, MQTT, Wipro) to Class 0, and cyberattacks to Class 1
Scaled evaluation to N = 20 independent randomized repetitions with exact Wilcoxon tests and Holm-Bonferroni corrections
Documented testbed topology and identified cross-dataset transfer (Edge-IIoTset, TON_IoT) as primary future work
